business_summary: KD Green Industries Limited engages in the manufacture, import, export, and trading of iron and steel products in India. The company offers GFRP rebar and byproducts; and eco-friendly building materials, such as autoclaved aerated concrete blocks, cement, and related products. It also provides AAC blocks under Green AAC Block brand name; and galvanized steel pipes and poles, green construction materials, fabricated infrastructure, structural steel, high masts, electro gratings, vehicle recycling, and infrastructure-related products under XTech brand name. In addition, the company manufactures and supplies galvanized and fabricated products, including crash barriers, cable trays and urban lighting systems, and pre-stressed concrete and fire clay products. The company was formerly known as Manbro Industries Limited and changed its name to KD Green Industries Limited in April 2026. KD Green Industries Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Guwahati, India.
